question: Makaravilakku is an annual festival held on Makar Sankranti in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

__
 
• **Makaravilakku is an annual festival held on Makar Sankranti in the Kerala states**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Makaravilakku** is an annual festival held on** Makara Sankranti** at the **Sabarimala Ayyappa** temple in **Kerala.**

 
 
• **Makara Jyothi **is a star that appears in the sky on Makara Samkramam, when the Sun moves from **dhanu Rasi** (Sagittarius) to **Makaram Rasi **(Capricorn) on the **first day** of the** Malayalam month** of **Makaram**, **January 14** (Makara Sankranti) this year.
 
• **Onam** is the most important and** popular festival** in **Kerala**. Celebrated with much** pomp** and** fervor**, Onam is a harvest festival.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
